job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a Hawaii ERS RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. It provides no evidence of the requested consultant retention term or seven-year contract ceiling; its reference to seven years concerns the primary consultant’s experience.
quotes: EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM OF THE STATE OF HAWAII REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES
The primary consultant to be assigned to the ERS must have a minimum of seven years experience providing domestic and international real estate consulting services to public pension plans.
